Session started 2026-06-04. 74 hands observed.

**Preflop SB strategy (40 opportunities as SB):** Fold h1,h51,h57,h67 (4 hands); limp h3,h7,h15,h17,h23,h25,h27,h29,h31,h33,h39,h43,h45,h49,h53,h55,h59,h63,h65,h69,h71,h73 (22 hands); raise 4x h5,h9,h11,h13,h19,h21,h35,h37,h41,h47,h61 (11 hands). ~28% raise (11/40), ~55% limp (22/40), ~10% fold (4/40). Raise range: broadway+ (AKs x2, QJ+, QTo) AND medium/big pocket pairs (TT, JJ) AND aces broadly (A4o, A6o, A7o, A9s). Limp range: ANY connector/1-gapper (suited or offsuit) AND weak kings AND weak aces AND any offsuit weak hand (incl. 8hTc, Jh7c, 3h4d, Ts6d, QhTc) AND small pocket pairs (33 confirmed) — EXTREMELY WIDE.

**BB holdings observed (35 samples):** Range is 100% — villain defends BB with any two cards.

**Postflop — positionally aggressive; strength of hand determines multi-barrel vs. give-up:**
- IP with air (no equity): fires ONE flop barrel, gives up on turn if called.
- IP with draw (OESD/flush/gutshot): fires MULTIPLE barrels aggressively.
- IP with made hand (value, including bottom pair): bets flop and beyond.
- OOP: checks air through; bets turn with weak pair after checking flop.
- IP flop aggression count: 21/21 — 100% c-bet rate IP (air, draws, AND made hands including bottom pair).

**KEY EXPLOIT:** SB raise range includes ANY ace and strong broadways broadly; limp range is near-any-two including small pairs, weak aces, random one-gappers. IP bets are 100% (21/21). Air bluffs are one-and-done; draws are multi-street; even bottom pair gets bet. Hero should call/raise flop with middle pair+ and strong draws. Do NOT fold middle pair or better to a single flop bet IP. ALSO: hero should 3-bet QQ+/AK vs villain SB raise — villain's raise range is wide enough that these hands have significant equity advantage. NOTE: Hero folded top pair (Ac7d) in h71 and hero folded gutshot+pair in h73 — hero continues to over-fold to single IP bets.
